### 2026 BMW X1

The third-generation BMW X1 arrived for 2023 and has continued to receive minor updates to keep it fresh. For 2026, BMW makes a series of small tweaks to its subcompact luxury SUV. [...] BMW’s trio of SUVs with coupelike rooflines loses a member for the 2026 model year. The compact BMW X4 will not be offered after 2025 due to a combination of factors. Sales have slowed, and the X4’s positioning with BMW’s SUV lineup has been weakened with the introduction of the new X2, which is larger and better equipped than the prior model, and the continued existence of the midsize X6. The X4 was first introduced for 2015, and the current generation arrived in 2019 following a redesign. Act [...] ### 2026 BMW X3

The fourth-generation BMW X3 just arrived for 2025, so changes are slight for 2026. BMW makes a Seal & Drive kit optional on the X3. The YouTube app is now accessible via the compact SUV’s infotainment system, as well. Finally, the X3’s available M Sport front brake calipers now have silver M logos instead of the brand’s signature tricolor look.
